summary: The selected 2026-10-18 forward-recovery decision closes the unavailable historical evidence-search/repeated-request task. Preserve surviving original evidence and unproved outcomes as Unknown; 439 inherited reservations and 46 later original records stay distinct and unreleased. Current relevant ownership and remaining-after-active capacity, together with demonstrated separation of generation, writable state, operation identity and outputs, may support independently admitted fresh work without reconstructing unrelated unavailable history. Shared destinations need demonstrated fencing or idempotency against old-actor interference. Missing records never prove empty relevant coverage; unresolved relevant conflicts block the affected operation, and a new ID cannot disguise an uncertain-effect retry. Use existing journals/custody, with no new recovery ledger, automatic release or blanket native authority. SC2 selects containers on the existing host with exact image/legal headless assets, current mounts/resource envelope, serial expensive runs, protocol/gameplay/replay/recording and output/recreation/recovery proof. It adds no separately procured machine, desktop or unrelated stronger-platform prerequisite. V3-ENV retains its separate two-machine blank-slate and unattended-lifecycle requirements. Source delivery records the decision only; native qualification and operational acceptance remain separate.
title: Unavailable historical evidence closes search, not original outcomes or holds
